description: This file defines the interface and class for serial port communication, including configuration options, platform-specific implementations, and control methods for serial port devices within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: An abstract class representing a serial port interface with platform-specific implementations for Windows and Linux, providing methods for configuration, data transfer, and control of serial port devices.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison based on the descriptor handle.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison based on the descriptor handle.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the serial port has encountered an error.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the serial port buffers.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier (port name).

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier (port name).

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the serial port (implementation-specific).

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the serial port (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the serial port (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Configures the serial port with detailed parameters.

methods.name: SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the serial port.

methods.name: SendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal on the serial port.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Handles actions when the port is opened.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Handles actions when the port is closed.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for the port to close within a timeout.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns the buffer for Linux or Windows descriptor.
